title: Executable authority composition
summary: The protected-domain runtime composes attribution, Access Control, a guarded admitted session, Security Manager, live Permission policy resolution, Security Effect, Permission, and the protected method without collapsing their authority roles.
invariants: Runtime path: attributed principal -> domain entry -> Access Control -> admitted session -> session guard -> Security Manager -> live Permission policy -> Security Effect -> Permission -> protected method.
Domain entry fails closed unless attribution, domain binding, policy resolution, Access Control ALLOW, proof requirements, and admission-policy liveness all succeed.
The Access Control receipt remains evidence and is never accepted as method authority.

provenance.claim: The runtime composes attribution, Access Control, admitted session, guard, Security Manager, live Permission policy, Security Effect, Permission and protected method, with fail-closed entry conditions.

AlchemyAccessControlledDomain.enter resolves and evaluates Access Control, requires proof by default, rechecks admission-policy liveness, builds guard/adapter/Security Manager/session, and keeps Permission independently enforced.
